groups.title: Interfaces & Protocols
groups.summary: SpaceWire and SpaceFibre links, CAN and 1553 buses, and the protocols that run over them.

groups.title: Processing Modules
groups.summary: Cores that process payload data on board, such as image compression and encryption.

groups.title: System Infrastructure
groups.summary: Cores that move data between the memories and the peripherals of an on-board system.

groups.title: Building Blocks
groups.summary: The fault-tolerant Open Logic entities that every core is built on.

projects.name: OpenWire
projects.summary: SpaceWire port with node interface: Data-Strobe encoding, link control, packets, time-codes and distributed interrupts.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenFibre
projects.summary: SpaceFibre port with 1 to 4 lanes, up to 32 virtual channels, quality of service, broadcast and error recovery.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenRMAP
projects.summary: RMAP target and initiator for reading and writing remote memory over SpaceWire and SpaceFibre networks.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenSPP
projects.summary: Space Packet service with APID routing and loss detection for up to 16 send and 16 receive ports, over SpaceWire, SpaceFibre or other links.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenCAN
projects.summary: CAN network core with nominal and redundant bus, bus redundancy management, CANopen services and time distribution.

projects.name: Open1553
projects.summary: Bus controller, remote terminal and bus monitor for the dual-redundant 1553 data bus, with the Manchester II codec in the core.

projects.name: OpenCompact
projects.summary: Lossless and near-lossless compressor for multispectral and hyperspectral images, with all predictors and entropy coders of the standard.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenCrypto
projects.summary: Authenticated encryption and decryption of real-time data streams with AES-GCM, key table and IV generation.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: OpenDMA
projects.summary: DMA core between AXI4 memory and AXI4-Stream peripherals, register-compatible with the AMD AXI DMA so that its drivers run unchanged.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.

projects.name: Open Logic FT
projects.summary: Fault-tolerant fork of Open Logic: RAMs and FIFOs with SECDED ECC, clock crossings with triplicated synchronisers.
projects.trl_status: Fully verified by simulation. Not yet tested on hardware, no flight heritage.
